learning.sceneConnection: “Let me confirm my understanding of the plan.”明确表达理解；单幅画面不能独立证明，不设局部框。
learning.association: “Let me confirm my understanding of the plan.”明确表达理解；单幅画面不能独立证明，不设局部框。
learning.collocation: my understanding of; a clear understanding
learning.example:
A: Let me confirm my understanding of the plan.
B: Sure. What will the first version include?
A: Search and filters. We'll exclude export and update the board.
B: Exactly. We agree on the scope now.
learning.exampleChinese:
A: 我来确认一下我对计划的理解。
B: 好。第一版会包含哪些内容？
A: 搜索和筛选。我们会排除导出功能，并更新白板。
B: 没错。现在我们对范围达成一致了。
